title: 木造階段ユニット
description: 樹上横丁のオリジナル形状から切り出した木造階段ユニット。原寸・底面中央原点。外部スキャン材質のみ単色PBRに置換し、該当するオリジナル布・印刷・瓦・紙テクスチャは保持。 静的なゲーム・VR向け素材。3Dプリント・製造用途は未検証。STLの座標値はmとして扱ってください。
descriptionEn: Timber Stair Flight extracted from original TreeTopYokocho geometry at authored scale, centered horizontally with the base at Y=0. External scanned materials are replaced with solid-color neutral PBR; applicable original cloth, printed, tile and paper source PNGs are embedded unchanged.  Static game/VR asset; not validated for manufacturing or 3D printing. STL does not encode units: interpret coordinates as meters. Static visual asset only. No colliders, rig, animation, gameplay scripts, runtime lighting, lightmap UV2, or engine-specific validation. STL is geometry-only and does not encode units; interpret as meters, Y up. Some sets contain separate pieces in their authored arrangement.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
